integrity: The proof derives the full commutator map, classifies every element-centralizer, counts each commutator fiber, and obtains the commuting probability by exact counting. An exhaustive checker reconstructs multiplication, centralizers, and fibers in seven finite examples, including non-prime field cases.
scientific_limitations: The algebra is the path algebra of the two-vertex generalized Kronecker quiver over a finite field.
The result does not classify arbitrary n-centralizer finite rings.
The six-centralizer specialization fills one excluded central-factor example but does not complete all excluded cases.
title: Commutator fibers and commuting probabilities of finite Kronecker path algebras
